$description: Figma family name -> CSS font stack. Figma variables hold the family as Figma displays it ('Proxima Nova Condensed'); web font services name it differently ('proxima-nova-condensed' on Adobe Fonts). Keyed by the exact Figma value; anything not listed is emitted quoted, as-is. Fallbacks are the measured substitutes from AIRMETHODS-SC-TOKEN-SPEC §8, so the page holds its measure while the kit loads or if a weight is missing from it.
